title: state: define ScenarioField struct
description: Define ScenarioField struct with 3 bullet prompts (trigger, value_moment, feeling) and HolePunchingResults

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL always have 3 scenario bullet fields
THE SYSTEM SHALL track hole punching results with scenario

event_driven.trigger: WHEN user fills in all 3 scenario bullets
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL enable hole punching validation

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT allow proceeding to Preview phase
unwanted.because: Trigger is essential for understanding user acquisition

postconditions: is_complete() method returns true only when all strings non-empty and holes addressed
invariants: All 3 bullet fields must be non-empty for completion
Hole punching must be complete for scenario to be valid

happy: Default has empty strings and is_complete()=false
Filling all bullets and holes makes is_complete()=true
edge: Whitespace-only bullets are treated as empty
Long scenario descriptions are preserved without truncation

similar: See Answer struct for similar field validation patterns
